subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is the young East Asian woman in <Picture 1>. Preserve her exact facial identity, short wavy black bob hair, cream sun hat, delicate youthful appearance, soft natural makeup, white oversized T-shirt with yellow star details and black handwritten text, light cream striped trousers, cream polka-dot shoulder bag, bracelets, watch, and overall fresh youthful summer styling.

<Subject 2> is the orange soda can in <Picture 2>. Preserve the exact tall slim aluminum-can proportions, bright orange body color, metallic gold top, large blue-and-white Chinese brand typography "北冰洋", vertical "OCEAN" lettering, smaller Chinese product text "橙汁汽水", and the recognizable overall packaging identity. Preserve the product as a premium chilled orange soda can with dense condensation, crisp metallic texture, and a strong refreshing citrus identity.

summary:

[reference generation] Create a premium 10-second beverage TVC using <Subject 2> as the dominant visual core and <Subject 1> as a supporting lifestyle anchor. No background reference image is provided, so generate the environment from text only. The commercial should feel like a high-end product film: tactile, crisp, premium, modern, and highly art-directed. Avoid generic sunshine-lifestyle advertising. Focus on product materiality, coldness, refreshment, and brand identity. Build the visual flow around “heat → chill → product reveal → opening impact → drinking payoff → hero packshot.” Use extreme macro cinematography, sculptural ice, citrus slices, droplets, glossy wet surfaces, dramatic light shaping, and a refined warm-orange / cool-cyan palette. Typography should appear selectively as elegant advertising design, never like plain subtitles. Sound design should use only physical sound effects and subtle ambience, with no background music.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1>: fully_preserved. Keep the same recognizable face, hairstyle, hat, outfit, accessories, body proportions, and overall youthful fresh styling from <Picture 1> in all shots where she appears.

<Subject 2>: fully_preserved. Keep the same can proportions, orange packaging, metallic gold top, large "北冰洋" branding, vertical "OCEAN" text, smaller "橙汁汽水" text, and overall packaging identity from <Picture 2> in all shots where the can appears.

Visual continuity: all shots must belong to one unified premium beverage-commercial visual world. The art direction should feel polished, cohesive, and expensive. The product must remain the visual priority.

Typography continuity: whenever text appears on screen, it should feel elegant, slim, refined, premium, and well-integrated into the frame. Avoid plain white. Prefer champagne gold, pale copper, warm amber, or deep desaturated cyan depending on the shot. The product-category text "橙汁汽水" must look tasteful and premium, never chunky, childish, or cheap-looking.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1] The video opens with an extreme macro shot of a fresh orange peel filling the frame. The camera is almost microscopic, showing pores, moisture, and subtle texture in luxurious detail. A cold droplet slowly slides across the peel. Hard warm sunlight creates bright highlights while deep cool cyan shadows shape the edge of the frame. The camera glides very slowly, establishing heat and citrus intensity.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, cut to an overhead premium still-life composition. Sculptural translucent ice cubes, sliced oranges, scattered droplets, and glossy reflections are arranged in a clean graphic composition on a pale reflective surface. One ice cube shifts and gently taps an orange slice, producing a tiny spray of droplets. A refined typography beat appears briefly within the composition: "橙汁汽水". The text should be slim, elegant, premium, and rendered in a pale champagne-gold or soft amber tone, not white.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.000, cut to a dramatic low-angle product reveal of <Subject 2>. The can stands monumental and iconic, covered in dense condensation. Warm rim light and cool cyan reflections define the metallic surface and printed branding. The camera tilts slowly upward along the can body, revealing the "北冰洋" logo and moving toward the gold top. A short elegant product-name super appears: "北冰洋". It fades in subtly from slight blur and low opacity, sharpens quickly, then disappears cleanly.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.200, cut to an ultra-close macro beauty shot of the can body. Show condensation beads, metallic texture, printed graphics, logo edge, and subtle reflections of orange and blue light. The camera slides slowly across the surface, emphasizing premium material quality and coldness. No person is visible. This shot is purely about tactile product beauty.

[Shot 5] At 00:04.100, cut to an extreme macro of the can top. A fingertip enters frame and snaps open the pull tab. At the exact opening moment, there is a sharp metallic crack followed immediately by vapor, carbonation fizz, micro-droplets, and pressure release. The can opening is shown in crisp slow-motion detail. A short modern typography beat appears right after the crack: "OCEAN". Use a deep desaturated cyan or cool metallic blue tone rather than white.

[Shot 6] At 00:05.300, cut to a liquid refreshment shot. Bright sparkling orange soda pours into a chilled glass filled with ice. Effervescence, bubbles, and liquid movement are shown clearly. The glass catches hard highlights while condensation forms on the outside. The camera remains tight and product-focused. The mood is cold, sparkling, and luxurious. No large text is necessary.

[Shot 7] At 00:06.500, cut to a stylish close or medium close-up of <Subject 1>. She holds <Subject 2> beside her face, calm and confident. The background is a clean premium studio set with soft cyan surfaces, warm orange accents, and controlled reflections. She slightly turns the can so the branding faces camera. The camera makes a subtle arc for elegant parallax. A small supporting text beat appears briefly: "橙汁汽水". Keep it slim, elegant, premium, and rendered in warm pale copper or champagne tone, not white.

[Shot 8] At 00:07.800, cut to a close side-profile shot of <Subject 1> taking one clean sip from <Subject 2>. The can remains clearly visible with condensation catching the light. As she lowers the can, her expression becomes subtly refreshed and satisfied. A few strands of hair move in a light breeze. The lighting cools slightly to visually express refreshment. Keep the shot restrained and elegant. No large text is needed here.

[Shot 9] At 00:08.800, cut to the final hero packshot. <Subject 2> stands perfectly centered on a glossy wet pedestal. Surround it with sculptural ice blocks, sliced oranges, suspended droplets, and a restrained splash crown behind the can. Cyan backlight refracts through the ice while a controlled warm key light gives the can depth and glow. The camera performs a slow precise push-in and settles into a luxurious stable beauty shot. During this final shot, premium end-card typography appears in layered sequence: first "北冰洋" as the main title, then "橙汁汽水" as a smaller supporting line. If composition allows, "OCEAN" may appear as a subtle tertiary accent. The typography must feel expensive, elegant, sharp, restrained, and fully integrated into the high-end packshot. Avoid white text.

overall_soundscape:

Use only clean, close-miked physical sound effects and subtle ambience. No background music. Emphasize tactile premium sound design: a droplet sliding on orange peel, tiny ice clicks, small splashes, condensation and surface moisture, controlled can handling, a sharp metallic pull-tab crack, pressurized hiss, dense carbonation fizz, liquid pouring into ice, tiny bubble textures, a soft sip, and a restrained final splash. Keep the mix spacious, crisp, commercial-grade, and intentionally sparse, allowing short moments of near-silence between key impacts.
